source.outlet: Chipotle Mexican Grill (press release via PR Newswire)
source.title: Chipotle Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results

figures.text: results released October 28, 2026, for the third quarter of 2026 (release dateline Oct. 28, 2026; 24/7 Wall St. 'Q3' agrees)
figures.quote: Total revenue in the third quarter of 2026 was $3.3 billion, an increase of 9.6% compared to the third quarter of 2025.

figures.text: total revenue up 9.6% year over year to $3.3 billion
figures.quote: Total revenue increased 9.6% to $3.3 billion

figures.text: comparable restaurant sales up 2.1%: average check up 1.3%, transactions up 0.8% (both sources give 2.1%)
figures.quote: Comparable restaurant sales increased 2.1%, including a 1.3% increase in average check and a 0.8% increase in transactions.

figures.text: estimate was 1.5%; third straight quarter of positive transaction growth (24/7 Wall St.)
figures.quote: Q3 same-store sales grew 2.1%, beating the 1.5% estimate and marking three straight quarters of positive transaction growth.

figures.text: CEO Scott Boatwright: three consecutive quarters show Recipe for Growth strategy is working
figures.quote: Three consecutive quarters of positive comparable transaction growth demonstrates that our Recipe for Growth strategy is working,

figures.text: Boatwright: stable or improving wallet share across income and age groups (24/7 Wall St.)
figures.quote: We saw stable or improving wallet share across the quarter, with broad strength across income and age cohorts.

figures.text: operating margin 13.7%, down from 15.9% (both sources)
figures.quote: Operating margin was 13.7%, a decrease from 15.9%

figures.text: restaurant level operating margin 23.3%, down from 24.5%
figures.quote: Restaurant level operating margin1 was 23.3%, a decrease from 24.5%

figures.text: diluted EPS $0.27 vs $0.29 a year earlier (third quarter of 2025)
figures.quote: Net income for the third quarter of 2026 was $339.9 million, or $0.27 per diluted share, compared to $382.1 million, or $0.29 per diluted share, in the third quarter of 2025.

figures.text: adjusted EPS $0.27 missed the $0.29 estimate (24/7 Wall St.)
figures.quote: Chipotle's adjusted earnings per share (EPS) of $0.27 missed the $0.29 estimate.

figures.text: promotions: back-to-school buy-one-get-one, free double protein (24/7 Wall St.)
figures.quote: including a back-to-school buy-one-get-one deal, free double protein, and Pollo Asado and Chili Lime Chips limited-time offers.

figures.text: labor 25.7% of revenue, up from 25.2% a year earlier
figures.quote: Labor costs in the third quarter of 2026 were 25.7% of total revenue, an increase from 25.2% in the third quarter of 2025.

figures.text: food, beverage and packaging 29.5% of revenue, down from 30.0%
figures.quote: Food, beverage and packaging costs in the third quarter of 2026 were 29.5% of total revenue, a decrease from 30.0% in the third quarter of 2025.

figures.text: decrease driven by menu price increases and tariff relief
figures.quote: The decrease was primarily driven by the benefit of menu price increases, tariff relief, and favorable limited-time offer mix.

figures.text: partially offset by inflation, mainly beef and freight, and higher protein usage
figures.quote: These benefits were partially offset by inflation, primarily in beef and freight, and higher protein usage.

figures.text: CFO Adam Rymer: menu prices raised 2.7% in the quarter to offset inflation (24/7 Wall St.)
figures.quote: the company raised menu prices 2.7% in Q3 to offset inflation

figures.text: 84 company-owned restaurants opened, 53 with a Chipotlane
figures.quote: Opened 84 company-owned restaurants, with 53 locations including a Chipotlane.

figures.text: Chipotlanes help guest access and convenience
figures.quote: Chipotlanes continue to perform well and are helping enhance guest access and convenience

figures.text: digital sales 38.8% of food and beverage revenue
figures.quote: Digital sales represented 38.8% of total food and beverage revenue

figures.text: Boatwright: progress on high-efficiency equipment rollout
figures.quote: making significant progress on our high-efficiency equipment rollout,

figures.text: full-year outlook: comparable sales growth in low single digits (both sources)
figures.quote: Full year comparable restaurant sales growth in the low single digit range

figures.text: 350 to 370 new restaurants incl. 10 to 15 international partner-operated (both sources give 350 to 370)
figures.quote: 350 to 370 new restaurant openings, which includes 10 to 15 international partner-operated restaurants.

figures.text: around 80% of new company-owned restaurants will have a Chipotlane
figures.quote: Around 80% of new company-owned restaurants will have a Chipotlane

figures.text: Rymer: October trends softened, like the broader industry (24/7 Wall St.)
figures.quote: October trends have softened, consistent with the broader industry.

figures.text: stock up 9% at $31.19 midday on October 29 (24/7 Wall St., published Oct 29, 2026)
figures.quote: Chipotle stock is at $31.19 in midday trading, up 9%.

figures.text: stock still down 16% year to date (24/7 Wall St.)
figures.quote: though Chipotle stock remains down 16% year to date (YTD).
